name: prism
description: PRISM by Entangled — open-source dashboard frames. Monorepo: prism-core and (later) editor, remote-ui, conformance, shells.

scripts.android:assets: npm run bundle --workspace prism-core && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('packages/core/dist/prism-runtime.js','shells/android/app/src/main/assets/prism-runtime.js');console.log('copied prism-runtime.js to android assets')"
scripts.build:veil: esbuild packages/core/src/popups.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=PrismPopups --target=es2018 --outfile=prototypes/prism-veil-extension/src/core-popups.js --banner:js="/* GENERATED from packages/core/src/popups.ts by npm run build:veil - do not edit. */" --footer:js="try { window.PrismPopups = PrismPopups; } catch (e) {}" && esbuild packages/core/src/popups.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=PrismPopups --target=es2018 --outfile=prototypes/prism-veil-extension/src/core-popups-iso.js --banner:js="/* GENERATED copy of core-popups.js for the ISOLATED world - Chromium 151 injects a file listed in two content_scripts entries only once. Do not edit. */" --footer:js="try { window.PrismPopups = PrismPopups; } catch (e) {}" && esbuild packages/core/src/reclaimed.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=PrismReclaimed --target=es2018 --outfile=prototypes/prism-veil-extension/src/core-reclaimed.js --banner:js="/* GENERATED from packages/core/src/reclaimed.ts by build:veil - do not edit. */" --footer:js="try { window.PrismReclaimed = PrismReclaimed; } catch (e) {}"
